newsitem.title: LATVIA: DAUGAVPILS CHAIN Q1 PRE-TAX 125,352 LATS.
newsitem.headline: DAUGAVPILS CHAIN Q1 PRE-TAX 125,352 LATS.

text.p: Daugavpils Chain had a first quarter pre-tax profit of 125,352 lats but a final profit figure was not available as the company was expecting a tax refund, the stock exchange said on Tuesday.

A spokesman for Daugavpils said the company overpaid tax worth 390,000 lats in the last financial year which meant that it does not have to pay tax this year. The tax issue will probably affect its 1997 balance sheet.
The bourse said that the company's net turnover was 1.81 million lats in the first quarter and its production expenses were 1.49 million lats. This led to 322,825 lat gross profit.
The company also had administrative expenses of 230,984 lats. The stock exchange did not give comparative figures.
